Sandbox_HWE_EnableEvent_tooltip: Master switch for the entire seasonal event. When enabled, costumed zombies, holiday candy, treat containers, and collectible props will spawn throughout Knox County.
Sandbox_HWE_UseCalendarTrigger_tooltip: When checked, the event automatically turns ON and OFF according to the configured calendar start and end schedule. Uncheck this if you want the event running continuously for testing.
Sandbox_HWE_StartSchedule_tooltip: The in-game calendar date and time when the event automatically begins. Format: Month/Day Hour:Minute (for example 10/15 00:00 for October 15 at midnight, or 07/29 23:30).
Sandbox_HWE_EndSchedule_tooltip: The in-game calendar date and time when the event automatically concludes and event zombie costumes are removed. Format: Month/Day Hour:Minute (for example 10/31 23:59).
Sandbox_HWE_CostumeChancePercent_tooltip: Percentage chance (0 to 100 percent) that newly encountered or spawned zombies will receive a Halloween costume archetype.
Sandbox_HWE_CandyDropChancePercent_toolt: Percentage chance (0 to 100 percent) that a defeated costumed zombie drops loose Halloween candy (Chocolates, Lollipops, Candy Packages, Mint Candies) if no treat container is rolled.
Sandbox_HWE_BagChancePercent_tooltip: Percentage chance (0 to 100 percent) that a costumed zombie carries a Pumpkin Treat Pail, Pumpkin Bucket, Witch Cauldron, or Trick-or-Treat bag on death. Candy will be stored inside the container.
Sandbox_HWE_BagCandyChancePercent_toolti: Chance (0 to 100 percent) that a dropped treat container is packed with Halloween candy instead of being empty.
Sandbox_HWE_MinBagCandy_tooltip: Minimum number of candy pieces packed inside a dropped event container or bag (Range: 1 to 5).
Sandbox_HWE_MaxBagCandy_tooltip: Maximum number of candy pieces packed inside a dropped event container or bag (Range: 1 to 5).
Sandbox_HWE_DecorationChanceOnZombiePerc: Chance (0 to 100 percent) that a costumed zombie carries a rare decorative Halloween prop (tabletop pumpkin, skull, candle cluster) as special death loot.
Sandbox_HWE_WorldDecorationChancePercent: Chance (0 to 100 percent) that eligible residential containers (wardrobes, desks, dressers) generate Halloween props when first explored.
Sandbox_HWE_CollectibleContainerChancePe: Chance (0 to 100 percent) that a world container loot roll awards a wearable collectible Pumpkin Pail or Witch Cauldron instead of a standalone decoration.
Sandbox_HWE_MaxDecorationsPerContainer_t: The hard cap on how many Halloween event items can be added to any single room container.
Sandbox_HWE_ZombieRescanMinutes_tooltip: How frequently the server sweeps loaded areas to dress zombies created by external horde managers or debug tools (Default: 1-2 minutes).
